|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Frost Bomb''' is a [[cold]] [[spell]] that places an orb that releases pulses which reduce [[life regeneration]], along with applying Cold [[Exposure]]. It will rapidly pulse before it explodes, dealing cold damage in an area. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Duration:''' increasing or reducing the [[duration]] of Frost Bomb will affect the time it takes for the skill to detonate, as well as the duration of the debuff. * '''Negative Resistances:''' Frost Bomb's [[Exposure]] can reduce resistances below 0, making enemies vulnerable to [[cold damage]]. * '''Hit:''' just the explosion counts as [[hit]] (in terms of {{il|Hextouch Support}} for example).
